name: Jausenstation Holzalm-Kaesealm
kurzbeschreibung:
**Welcome to the Jausenstation Holzalm-Käsealm in Tirol!**

Discover a cozy mountain retreat nestled in the heart of the **Tiroler Alps**, where fresh mountain air and hearty flavors come together. Our rustic **Jausenstation** offers a warm welcome to hikers, skiers, and travelers alike.

Indulge in traditional **Tiroler** specialties like **Kaiserschmarrn**, creamy **Käsekrainer**, and crispy **Speckknödel**, all made with locally sourced ingredients. Pair your meal with a frothy **Tiroler Bier** or a steaming cup of **Almkäse** soup.

After refueling, explore the stunning trails around **Holzalm** and **Käsealm**, or simply relax with breathtaking views of the surrounding peaks. Whether you're seeking adventure or tranquility, this hidden gem promises an unforgettable experience in the great outdoors.

**Come visit us in the **Zillertal** or **Ötztal** valleys—your taste buds and soul will thank you!**
